name: Access Control
description: Controls that limit system access to authorized users, processes, and devices, and govern the types of transactions and functions those users are permitted to exercise.

name: Audit and Accountability
description: Controls that ensure events are logged, logs are reviewed, and actions can be traced back to individual users.

name: Identification and Authentication
description: Controls that verify the identity of users, processes, and devices before granting access.

name: Configuration Management
description: Controls that establish and maintain baseline configurations and manage changes to systems in a controlled manner.

name: System and Communications Protection
description: Controls that protect the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted and processed information, including boundary protection.

name: Awareness and Training
description: Controls that ensure personnel are aware of security risks and receive role-appropriate security training.
